# contextInfo

## Overview
Context information and parameter info handlers (DartDeclarationRangeHandler).

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.contextInfo.DartDeclarationRangeHandler

## Invariants
- Provides declaration text ranges for IDE code context overlays.

## Side Effects
- Read-only PSI range queries.
